description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Search HuggingFace Hub for ML models. Specify a keyword (e.g. 'bert', 'llama', 'stable diffusion') and optional task filter (e.g. 'text-classification', 'text-generation', 'image-classification'). Returns top results sorted by downloads or likes, including model ID, author, pipeline task, framework library, download count, likes count, and tags.
